summary: Iteration 9 — Login-cover, Watermark and Our-Story features tested end-to-end. Backend: 21/21 pytest cases passed (public GETs, admin auth-gating 401/403, PUT/DELETE roundtrips, StoryIn validation for empty title/body and >6 images, plus regression on season/TTC fields/export CSV/habits). Frontend: Admin dashboard exposes nav-login-cover, nav-watermark, nav-our-story rows; login-cover admin screen shows correct save-disabled behaviour, pick/remove buttons and 'Image d'accueil supprimée' toast; the login screen hero correctly reflects the seeded login-cover (data URL detected in DOM); watermark preview and biz catalog render the watermark at opacity 0.06 and product cards remain tappable (product-detail opens on tap); admin PUT of Our Story is persisted (verified via GET /api/our-story) and the client icon `open-our-story` routes to /our-story showing story-title and story-body from the saved values; our-story tab is not exposed in the tab bar (hidden). Cleanup restored default story and removed cover/watermark seeds.
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend our-story.tsx caps MAX_IMAGES at 4, while backend StoryIn allows up to 6 (max_length=6). Not a bug (feature spec is 'up to 4'), but consider aligning the backend cap with the product decision (4) so accidental external PUTs match the client contract.

Login screen testIDs are `login-email-input`/`login-password-input`/`login-submit-button` (with -input/-button suffixes) — several documented flows in the review referenced shorter names; keep the testID naming convention consistent across screens for future test authors.
seed_data_creation: During testing, seeded login-cover and watermark with a 1x1 base64 PNG and set our-story to 'Test histoire' / 'Corps du test'. All were reset/deleted at test end (login-cover DELETE 204, watermark DELETE 204, our-story PUT default title+body).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter9 media/story endpoints are backed by db.settings keyed by 'login_cover' / 'watermark' / 'our_story'. Public GETs never require auth; admin routes require Bearer admin token — non-admin returns 403, no token returns 401. Frontend login screen uses tab-supplier + login-email-input/login-password-input/login-submit-button testIDs. Biz catalog product cards use testIDs `product-card-<id>`. Watermark parent opacity should read 0.06 in computed style. The `open-our-story` icon on the catalog header routes to /our-story where the client screen exposes `story-title` and `story-body` testIDs.
